android.desc:
My Tasks is a fast, clean to-do list that runs completely offline on your device – no account, no cloud, no ads, and no tracking. No sign-up, no registration, no data collection.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
The app works entirely offline. No data is collected, no analytics tools are embedded, and nothing is sent to any server. You don't need an account or an email address. Everything stays on your device.

TRANSFER WITHOUT THE CLOUD
Export lists as a file or move them straight to another device with a QR code. Scan once, done – no internet, no account, and your tasks never touch anyone's server. Great for backups, too.

FEATURES
✔ Multiple lists for different areas of your life
✔ Due dates, priorities, and recurring tasks (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly)
✔ Reminders with notifications – even after a device restart
✔ Attach photos and voice notes directly to tasks
✔ Calendar view for everything coming up
✔ Search, filters (All / Open / Done), and free drag & drop sorting
✔ Color-coded lists for quick orientation
✔ Export and import as a file or QR code
✔ Home screen widget for a quick overview
✔ Light and dark theme, follows your system automatically

12 LANGUAGES
German, English, French, Spanish, Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Arabic, Japanese, Russian, and Korean. The app follows your system language automatically and can be switched manually at any time.

FREE TO USE
Up to 10 lists are free forever. The optional Pro upgrade (one-time purchase, no subscription) unlocks unlimited lists.

No ads. No subscription trap. No data collection.
